_comment: Phase 4d oracle provenance stub, seeded by Task 2. Downstream fixture manifests (Tasks 3/4) carry the `oracle` field so every generated fixture records which oracle produced it.

segmentation_oracle.artifact: VRCTS xml (<name>_chan_<n>.xml per channel), written during segmentation
segmentation_oracle.note: Full BLSTM spectral SAD inference runs end-to-end and writes valid, parseable VRCTS segmentation before any crash.

known_limitation.symptom: solo -s (and any mode that reaches saveAndUpdate) SIGSEGVs (exit 139) AFTER writing the VRCTS output
known_limitation.site: BLSTMNeuralNetwork::saveWeights -> iof::fmtr filename formatting (best-weight persistence path)
known_limitation.cause: resurrection artifact: the 2015 binary links libstdc++.6 current 7.20.0 (gcc 4.9); the closest obtainable x86_64 macOS libstdc++ is gcc-14 current 7.33.0, and the binary's old-ABI std::string / iof::fmtr interaction faults under it. The 2015 legacy dir contains weights_bestNNWeight_1_*.mat, proving saveWeights completed on the original toolchain.
known_limitation.impact: none on the segmentation oracle (VRCTS is written pre-crash); the MultiConfigResults .mat (cost/counter columns) is NOT written because saveResults runs after the crashing saveAndUpdate. Extractors must tolerate exit 139 and consume the VRCTS output.
known_limitation.fallback_available: LIVE since Task 3: the results-.mat numeric columns come from the -ffast-math rebuild oracle (tools/oracle_harness/build.sh --fastmath -> oracle_harness_fastmath + phase4d_parity.cpp), which exits cleanly and scores for real; per-fixture provenance lives in tests/reference_data/phase4d/phase4d_parity_manifest.json (oracle: real-binary for VRCTS, fastmath-rebuild for mcr). This binary remains the segmentation oracle.
